name: opencode-teamwork
description: Antigravity-style Teamwork multi-agent orchestration for OpenCode — 10 agents, 6 topologies, 7 slash commands, and a code-owned run engine (event log, DAG dispatch, verified evidence, budget). Replica of Google Antigravity's /teamwork-preview.

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external zod
scripts.build:server: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/server.js --target node --format esm --external zod
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external zod
scripts.build:templates: bun build src/templates.ts --outfile dist/templates.js --target node --format esm --external zod
scripts.build:support: bun build src/worktree.ts src/cost.ts src/state.ts src/artifacts.ts src/events.ts src/engine.ts src/policy.ts src/guard.ts src/tools.ts --outdir dist --root src --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external zod
scripts.build:assets: bun -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('dist/cli', { recursive: true }); cpSync('src/cli/templates', 'dist/cli/templates', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:plugin && bun run build:server && bun run build:cli && bun run build:templates && bun run build:support && bun run build:assets && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run smoke && bun run e2e && bun run integration
